content.prompt: List the elements of $X=\{x\in\mathbb Z\text{ where }x^2\le9\}$.

answer.worked:
The integers from $-3$ to 3 have squares at most 9. Integers with magnitude at least 4 have squares at least 16.
$$X=\{-3,-2,-1,0,1,2,3\}.$$
